youtube.title: Morning Prayer for Today | Psalm 59:16 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. Start the day singing, even if it's just in your head.

"But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble." Psalm 59:16 (KJV)

But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning:

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.
